BURHAN:v2p55/r3.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v2p55/r3.speaker: author
BURHAN:v2p55/r3.claim: The apparent conflict with the statement that they will not conceal anything is resolved either by different stages of Judgment, when they sometimes lie, or by lying tongues versus truthful limbs commanded to speak.
BURHAN:v2p55/r3.anchor: والجواب من وجهين أحدهما أن للقيامة مواطن ففي بعضها يقع منهم الكذب وفي بعضها لا يقع

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v4p466#2/r3.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v4p466#2/r3.speaker: ابن عباس
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v4p466#2/r3.claim: Ibn Abbas explains that, seeing only believers enter Paradise, they agreed to deny shirk; God sealed their mouths and their limbs testified.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v4p466#2/r3.anchor: قال ابن عباس: لما رأوا أنه لا يدخل الجنة إلا مؤمن قالوا: تعالوا فلنجحد وقالوا: ما كنا مشركين

SAMIN-DURR:4:42/r1.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:4:42/r1.speaker: غير مسمى
SAMIN-DURR:4:42/r1.claim: One parse makes يومئذ an adverb governed by يود.
SAMIN-DURR:4:42/r1.anchor: فيه ثلاثة أقوال، أحدها: أنه معمول ل " يود " أي:

SAMIN-DURR:4:42/r2.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:4:42/r2.speaker: أبو البقاء
SAMIN-DURR:4:42/r2.claim: Abu al-Baqa makes يوم governed by شهيدا, with يود adjectival to يوم and an omitted فيه; 2:48 is cited as a parallel.
SAMIN-DURR:4:42/r2.anchor: قاله أبو البقاء، قال " وعلى هذا يكون " يود " صفة ل " يوم " ، والعائد محذوف تقديره: فيه

SAMIN-DURR:4:42/r3.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:4:42/r3.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:4:42/r3.claim: The author finds a clear problem in Abu al-Baqa’s analysis.

SAMIN-DURR:4:42/r4.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:4:42/r4.speaker: الحوفي
SAMIN-DURR:4:42/r4.claim: Al-Hawfi says يوم is built through annexation to إذ; an adverb annexed to an indeclinable can itself be indeclinable, and إذ functions nominally after annexation.
SAMIN-DURR:4:42/r4.anchor: قاله الحوفي، قال: لأن الظرف إذا أضيف إلى غير متمكن جاز بناؤه معه.

SAMIN-DURR:4:42/r5.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:4:42/r5.speaker: قيل
SAMIN-DURR:4:42/r5.claim: The tanwīn on إذ compensates for the earlier clause about bringing a witness from every community, making الرسول generic.
SAMIN-DURR:4:42/r5.anchor: فقيل: عوض من الجملة الأولى في قوله { جئنا من كل } أي: يوم إذ جئنا من كل أمة بشهيد

SAMIN-DURR:4:42/r6.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:4:42/r6.speaker: قيل
SAMIN-DURR:4:42/r6.claim: Alternatively, the tanwīn compensates for وجئنا بك, with الرسول referring specifically to Muhammad.
SAMIN-DURR:4:42/r6.anchor: وقيل: عوض من الجملة الأخيرة، وهي " وجئنا بك " ، ويكون المراد بالرسول محمدا صلى الله عليه وسلم.

SAMIN-DURR:4:42/r7.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:4:42/r7.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:4:42/r7.claim: The wording names the Messenger by his honored office instead of saying وعصوك, magnifying his rank and dignity.
SAMIN-DURR:4:42/r7.anchor: وكان النظم " وعصوك " ولكن أبرز ظاهرا بصفة الرسالة تنويها بقدره وشرفه.

SAMIN-DURR:4:42/r8.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:4:42/r8.speaker: غير مسمى
SAMIN-DURR:4:42/r8.claim: وعصوا may coordinate with كفروا in the same relative clause, describing people combining disbelief with disobedience.
SAMIN-DURR:4:42/r8.anchor: أحدها: أنها جملة معطوفة على " كفروا " فتكون صلة، فيكونون جامعين بين كفر ومعصية.

SAMIN-DURR:4:42/r9.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:4:42/r9.speaker: قيل
SAMIN-DURR:4:42/r9.claim: A second analysis treats وعصوا as the relative clause of another relative pronoun, yielding two groups.
SAMIN-DURR:4:42/r9.anchor: وقيل: بل هي صلة لموصول آخر فيكونون طائفتين.

SAMIN-DURR:4:42/r10.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:4:42/r10.speaker: قيل
SAMIN-DURR:4:42/r10.claim: A third analysis makes وعصوا a circumstantial clause from كفروا, with قد understood.

SAMIN-DURR:4:42/r11.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:4:42/r11.speaker: يحيى وأبو السمال
SAMIN-DURR:4:42/r11.claim: Yahya and Abu al-Sammal read وعصوا with a kasra on the waw, preserving its original vowel.
SAMIN-DURR:4:42/r11.anchor: وقرأ يحيى وأبو السمال: " وعصوا الرسول " بكسر الواو على الأصل.

SAMIN-DURR:4:42#2/r1.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:4:42#2/r1.speaker: الجمهور
SAMIN-DURR:4:42#2/r1.claim: If لو retains its usual conditional force, يود has an omitted object meaning leveling the earth over them, and its omitted result is that they would rejoice.
SAMIN-DURR:4:42#2/r1.anchor: إن قيل: إن " لو " على بابها كما هو قول الجمهور فمفعول " يود " محذوف أي: يود الذين كفروا تسوية الأرض [بهم]

SAMIN-DURR:4:42#2/r2.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:4:42#2/r2.speaker: غير مسمى
SAMIN-DURR:4:42#2/r2.claim: If لو is a verbal noun particle, it and its clause serve as the object of يود and have no conditional result.
SAMIN-DURR:4:42#2/r2.anchor: وإن قيل: إنها مصدرية كانت هي وما بعدها في محل مفعول " يود " ولا جواب لها حينئذ

SAMIN-DURR:4:42#2/r3.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:4:42#2/r3.speaker: أبو البقاء
SAMIN-DURR:4:42#2/r3.claim: Abu al-Baqa treats عصوا الرسول as a circumstantial clause with قد understood, inserted between يود and its object, and takes لو as أن; the author rejects calling it parenthetical because it belongs to the relative clause governed by the verb.
SAMIN-DURR:4:42#2/r3.anchor: قال أبو البقاء " وعصو الرسول " في موضع الحال، و " قد " مرادة، وهي معترضة بين " يود " وبين مفعولها

SAMIN-DURR:4:42#2/r4.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:4:42#2/r4.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:4:42#2/r4.claim: The author says the circumstantial clause is not parenthetical: it belongs among the relative clause’s dependencies, like مسرعين in ضرب الذين جاؤوا مسرعين زيدا.
SAMIN-DURR:4:42#2/r4.anchor: وفي جعله الجملة الحالية معترضة بين المفعول وعامله نظر لا يخفى، لأنها من جملة متعلقات العامل الذي هو صلة للموصول

SAMIN-DURR:4:42#2/r5.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:4:42#2/r5.speaker: أبو عمرو وابن كثير وعاصم
SAMIN-DURR:4:42#2/r5.claim: Abu Amr, Ibn Kathir, and Asim read تسوى with damma on tāʾ and a light sīn as a passive verb.
SAMIN-DURR:4:42#2/r5.anchor: وقرأ أبو عمرو وابن كثير وعاصم " تسوى " بضم التاء وتخفيف السين مبنيا للمفعول.

SAMIN-DURR:4:42#2/r6.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:4:42#2/r6.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:4:42#2/r6.claim: On the passive reading, they may wish the earth to split and swallow them; باء then means على.
SAMIN-DURR:4:42#2/r6.anchor: إما على أن الأرض تنشق وتبتلعهم، وتكون الباء بمعنى " على "

SAMIN-DURR:4:42#2/r7.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:4:42#2/r7.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:4:42#2/r7.claim: Alternatively, they wish to become dust like animals; the underlying sense is that God make them level with the earth, expressed by reversing the construction as in the cap example.
SAMIN-DURR:4:42#2/r7.anchor: وإما على أنهم يودون أن لو صاروا ترابا كالبهائم، والأصل: يودون أن الله يسويهم بالأرض

SAMIN-DURR:4:42#2/r8.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:4:42#2/r8.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:4:42#2/r8.claim: A further explanation is that they wish to be buried in the earth, essentially the same as being swallowed by it.
SAMIN-DURR:4:42#2/r8.anchor: وإما على أنهم يودون لو يدفنون فيها، وهو كمعنى القول الأول

SAMIN-DURR:4:42#2/r9.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:4:42#2/r9.speaker: قيل
SAMIN-DURR:4:42#2/r9.claim: Another gloss is that the earth be made equal with them, taking what is upon it from them as ransom.
SAMIN-DURR:4:42#2/r9.anchor: وقيل: لو تعدل بهم الأرض أي: يؤخذ ما عليها منهم فدية.

SAMIN-DURR:4:42#2/r10.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:4:42#2/r10.speaker: حمزة والكسائي
SAMIN-DURR:4:42#2/r10.claim: Hamza and al-Kisai read تسوى with an open tāʾ and light sīn; its underlying form is تتسوى with one tāʾ deleted.
SAMIN-DURR:4:42#2/r10.anchor: وقرأ حمزة والكسائي: تسوى بفتحها والتخفيف

SAMIN-DURR:4:42#2/r11.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:4:42#2/r11.speaker: نافع وابن عامر
SAMIN-DURR:4:42#2/r11.claim: Nafi and Ibn Amir read the form with gemination; one of the two tāʾs is deleted, and the same interpretations apply with the earth overtly made subject.
SAMIN-DURR:4:42#2/r11.anchor: ونافع وابن عامر بالتثقيل. فأما القراءة الأولى فمعناها: أنهم يودون أن الله تعالى يسوي بهم الأرض

SAMIN-DURR:4:42#3/r1.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:4:42#3/r1.speaker: غير مسمى
SAMIN-DURR:4:42#3/r1.claim: As coordination of constituents, ولا يكتمون may join the wished-for object: they wish both earth-leveling and the end of concealment, with لو nominal.
SAMIN-DURR:4:42#3/r1.anchor: عطفا على مفعول " يود " أي: يودون تسوية الأرض بهم وانتفاء كتمان الحديث

SAMIN-DURR:4:42#3/r2.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:4:42#3/r2.speaker: غير مسمى
SAMIN-DURR:4:42#3/r2.claim: Another constituent-level analysis coordinates ولا يكتمون with an omitted object of يود; a conditional لو is considered remote here.
SAMIN-DURR:4:42#3/r2.anchor: ويبعد جعلها حرفا لما كان سيقع لوقوع غيره، ويكون " ولا يكتمون " عطفا على مفعول " يود " المحذوف.

SAMIN-DURR:4:42#3/r3.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:4:42#3/r3.speaker: غير مسمى
SAMIN-DURR:4:42#3/r3.claim: As coordination of clauses, ولا يكتمون may join يود, reporting both their wish and inability to conceal in some situations but not others.
SAMIN-DURR:4:42#3/r3.anchor: أخبر تعالى عنهم بخبرين أحدهما: الودادة لكذا، والثاني: أنهم لا يقدرون على الكتم

SAMIN-DURR:4:42#3/r4.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:4:42#3/r4.speaker: غير مسمى
SAMIN-DURR:4:42#3/r4.claim: Alternatively, it coordinates with لو and its clause; with the object and result omitted, three clauses are reported: wishing, the لو condition, and non-concealment.
SAMIN-DURR:4:42#3/r4.anchor: ويكون " ولا يكتمون " عطفا على " لو " وما في حيزها، ويكون تعالى قد أخبر عنهم بثلاث جمل

SAMIN-DURR:4:42#3/r5.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:4:42#3/r5.speaker: غير مسمى
SAMIN-DURR:4:42#3/r5.claim: As a circumstantial clause from the pronoun in بهم, ولا يكتمون is governed by تسوى; لو may be nominal or conditional.
SAMIN-DURR:4:42#3/r5.anchor: أن تكون حالا من الضمير في " بهم "

SAMIN-DURR:4:42#3/r6.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:4:42#3/r6.speaker: غير مسمى
SAMIN-DURR:4:42#3/r6.claim: It may instead be circumstantial from الذين كفروا, governed by يود and qualifying their wish; لو is nominal here.

SAMIN-DURR:4:42#3/r7.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:4:42#3/r7.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:4:42#3/r7.claim: يكتمون takes two objects, apparently reaching one through a preposition: the underlying phrase is ولا يكتمون من الله حديثا.
SAMIN-DURR:4:42#3/r7.anchor: يتعدى لاثنين، والظاهر أنه يصل إلى أحدهما بالحرف، والأصل: ولا يكتمون من الله حديثا.

ZAJJAJ:v2p53/r3.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v2p53/r3.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v2p53/r3.claim: The preferred vowel on the wāw of ʿaṣaw is ḍamma to resolve adjacent sukūns; kasra is also permissible.
ZAJJAJ:v2p53/r3.anchor: الاختيار الضم في الواو في عصوا الرسول، لالتقاء الساكنين والكسر جائز، وقد فسرناه فيما مضى.

ZAJJAJ:v2p53/r4.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v2p53/r4.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v2p53/r4.claim: The mīm in bihim may be read with either ḍamma or kasra.

ZAJJAJ:v2p53/r5.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v2p53/r5.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v2p53/r5.claim: They wish they had not been resurrected and had been made level with the earth.
ZAJJAJ:v2p53/r5.anchor: أي يودون أنهم لم يبعثوا، وأنهم كانوا والأرض سواء.

ZAJJAJ:v2p53/r6.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v2p53/r6.speaker: أهل التفسير
ZAJJAJ:v2p53/r6.claim: Exegetical reports say animals will become dust on Judgment Day, so the condemned wish to become dust too.
ZAJJAJ:v2p53/r6.anchor: وقد جاء في التفسير أن البهائم يوم القيامة تصير ترابا. فيودون أنهم يصيرون ترابا.

ZAJJAJ:v2p54/r1.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v2p54/r1.speaker: بعضهم
ZAJJAJ:v2p54/r1.claim: Some attach wa-lā yaktumūna to the wish: they wished the earth leveled over them and that they had not concealed anything, since they lied by denying their former polytheism.
ZAJJAJ:v2p54/r1.anchor: قال بعضهم: ودوا أن الأرض سويت بهم وأنهم لم يكتموا الله حديثا، لأن قولهم: (والله ربنا ما كنا مشركين) قد كذبوا فيه

ZAJJAJ:v2p54/r2.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v2p54/r2.speaker: بعضهم
ZAJJAJ:v2p54/r2.claim: Others take the clause as independent: their deeds are manifest to God, so they cannot conceal them.
ZAJJAJ:v2p54/r2.anchor: وقال بعضهم: (ولا يكتمون الله حديثا). مستأنف لأن ما عملوه ظاهر عند الله لا يقدرون على كتمه.

ASAD-NOTES:4:41#n53/r1.author: Muhammad Asad
ASAD-NOTES:4:41#n53/r1.speaker: author
ASAD-NOTES:4:41#n53/r1.claim: The phrase literally means that the earth would become level with them.

ASAD-NOTES:4:41#n53/r2.author: Muhammad Asad
ASAD-NOTES:4:41#n53/r2.speaker: author
ASAD-NOTES:4:41#n53/r2.claim: “The apostle” is probably generic, referring to every apostle who preached God's message across time.
ASAD-NOTES:4:41#n53/r2.anchor: The term "the apostle" is probably used here in its generic sense, and refers to all the apostles who preached God's message at one time or another.

FARISI-HUJJA:v3p161/r1.author: Abū ʿAlī al-Fārisī
FARISI-HUJJA:v3p161/r1.speaker: author
FARISI-HUJJA:v3p161/r1.claim: The source notes disagreement over opening the tāʾ in tasawwā but names no readers or arguments in this excerpt.
FARISI-HUJJA:v3p161/r1.anchor: اختلفوا في فتح التاء في قوله تعالى : تسوى

IBNKHALAWAYH-HUJJA:v1p124/r1.author: Ibn Khālawayh (attr.)
IBNKHALAWAYH-HUJJA:v1p124/r1.speaker: author
IBNKHALAWAYH-HUJJA:v1p124/r1.claim: The phrase is read with ḍamma on tāʾ and light form, or fatḥa and doubled form; the author refers to his earlier explanation of their meanings.
IBNKHALAWAYH-HUJJA:v1p124/r1.anchor: يقرا بضم التاء والتخفيف وبفتحها والتشديد وقد ذكرت من علة ذلك فيما سلف ما يدل على معناه

IBNKHALAWAYH-HUJJA:v1p124/r2.author: Ibn Khālawayh (attr.)
IBNKHALAWAYH-HUJJA:v1p124/r2.speaker: author
IBNKHALAWAYH-HUJJA:v1p124/r2.claim: Kasra on both hāʾ and mīm reflects adjacency to bāʾ and sukūn at the word boundary.
IBNKHALAWAYH-HUJJA:v1p124/r2.anchor: فالحجة لمن كسرهما أنه كسر الهاء لمجاورة الباء والميم لالتقاء الساكنين

IBNKHALAWAYH-HUJJA:v1p124/r3.author: Ibn Khālawayh (attr.)
IBNKHALAWAYH-HUJJA:v1p124/r3.speaker: author
IBNKHALAWAYH-HUJJA:v1p124/r3.claim: Ḍamma on both pronoun letters restores their original vowels before bāʾ.
IBNKHALAWAYH-HUJJA:v1p124/r3.anchor: والحجة لمن صمهما أنه ردهما إلى الأصل الذي كانا عليه قبل دخول الباء

IBNKHALAWAYH-HUJJA:v1p124/r4.author: Ibn Khālawayh (attr.)
IBNKHALAWAYH-HUJJA:v1p124/r4.speaker: author
IBNKHALAWAYH-HUJJA:v1p124/r4.claim: A third reading kasras hāʾ beside bāʾ but keeps mīm in its original state; it drops the following wāw for ease.
IBNKHALAWAYH-HUJJA:v1p124/r4.anchor: ومن كسر الهاء فلمجاورة الباء وبقي الميم على أصل ما كانت عليه وأسقط الواو بعدها تخفيفا

NASHR:v2p249/r3.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v2p249/r3.speaker: author
NASHR:v2p249/r3.claim: Ḥamza, al-Kisāʾī, and Khalaf use fatḥa on tāʾ with a light sīn; the Medinese and Ibn ʿĀmir use a doubled sīn; the rest use ḍamma on tāʾ with light sīn.
NASHR:v2p249/r3.anchor: قرأ حمزة والكسائي، وخلف بفتح التاء وتخفيف السين. وقرأ المدنيان وابن عامر بفتح التاء وتشديد السين، وقرأ الباقون بضم التاء وتخفيف السين

QIRAAT-ER:4:42:9#1/r1.author: QIRAAT-ER
QIRAAT-ER:4:42:9#1/r1.speaker: author
QIRAAT-ER:4:42:9#1/r1.claim: The active Form II reading makes the earth itself perform the leveling, rather than being passively leveled.
QIRAAT-ER:4:42:9#1/r1.anchor: Active voice Form II with tāʾ-marbūṭa of ta-faʿʿul origin or imperfect active — the earth itself performs the leveling

QIRAAT-ER:4:42:9#2/r1.author: QIRAAT-ER
QIRAAT-ER:4:42:9#2/r1.speaker: author
QIRAAT-ER:4:42:9#2/r1.claim: Assimilating tāʾ into sīn yields Form V and a reflexive sense: the earth makes itself level upon them.
QIRAAT-ER:4:42:9#2/r1.anchor: Assimilation of tāʾ into sīn — Form V tataṣawwā with ta- assimilated

QIRAAT-ER:4:42:11#1/r1.author: QIRAAT-ER
QIRAAT-ER:4:42:11#1/r1.speaker: author
QIRAAT-ER:4:42:11#1/r1.claim: Kasra on the mīm instead of ḍamma is a liaison vowel; some readers use it before a pause or consonant.
QIRAAT-ER:4:42:11#1/r1.anchor: Kasra on mīm instead of ḍamma — different liaison vowel; some readers use kasra

QIRAAT-ER:4:42:11#2/r1.author: QIRAAT-ER
QIRAAT-ER:4:42:11#2/r1.speaker: author
QIRAAT-ER:4:42:11#2/r1.claim: The pronoun variant bihumu has ḍamma on hāʾ rather than bihimu, reflecting Hijazi and Tamimi dialectal voweling.
QIRAAT-ER:4:42:11#2/r1.anchor: Ḍamma on hāʾ (bihumu vs bihimu) — dialectal variation in pronoun voweling; Ḥijāzī vs Tamīmī

ABDURRAZZAQ:v1p160#3/r1.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Ṣanʿānī
ABDURRAZZAQ:v1p160#3/r1.speaker: ابن عباس
ABDURRAZZAQ:v1p160#3/r1.claim: Ibn ʿAbbas says the polytheists deny their shirk when they see that God forgives Muslims’ sins but not shirk; God then seals their mouths and their limbs testify, so they wish the earth would level over them and cannot conceal anything.
ABDURRAZZAQ:v1p160#3/r1.anchor: قال ابن عباس أما قوله ﴿ ثم لم تكن فتنتهم إلا أن قالوا والله ربنا ما كنا مشركين ﴾ فإنهم لما رأوا يوم القيامة

ABDURRAZZAQ:v1p160#3/r2.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Ṣanʿānī
ABDURRAZZAQ:v1p160#3/r2.speaker: ابن عباس
ABDURRAZZAQ:v1p160#3/r2.claim: Ibn ʿAbbas reconciles the verses by distinguishing stages: after the first trumpet blast there are no family ties or questions, but after the next blast people rise and question one another.
ABDURRAZZAQ:v1p160#3/r2.anchor: وأما قوله ﴿ فلا أنساب بينهم يومئذ ولا يتساءلون ﴾ فإنه إذا نفخ في الصور فصعق من في السماوات

ABDURRAZZAQ:v1p160#3/r3.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Ṣanʿānī
ABDURRAZZAQ:v1p160#3/r3.speaker: ابن عباس
ABDURRAZZAQ:v1p160#3/r3.claim: Ibn ʿAbbas explains that the earth was created first, then the smoky heaven was formed into seven heavens in two days; the earth was spread out afterward with mountains, rivers, trees, and seas.
ABDURRAZZAQ:v1p160#3/r3.anchor: وأما قوله ﴿ قل أئنكم لتكفرون بالذي خلق الأرض في يومين ﴾ فإن الأرض خلقت قبل السماء

ABDURRAZZAQ:v1p162/r1.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Ṣanʿānī
ABDURRAZZAQ:v1p162/r1.speaker: مجاهد
ABDURRAZZAQ:v1p162/r1.claim: Mujahid says the earth was created before the heaven; smoke rose from the earth, and the heaven was created afterward.
ABDURRAZZAQ:v1p162/r1.anchor: عن مجاهد قال فخلق الله الأرض قبل السماء فثار من الأرض دخان ثم خلقت السماء بعد

ABDURRAZZAQ:v1p162/r2.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Ṣanʿānī
ABDURRAZZAQ:v1p162/r2.speaker: مجاهد
ABDURRAZZAQ:v1p162/r2.claim: Mujahid explains “after that” in the earth’s spreading as “along with that,” saying maʿa and baʿda can mean the same in Arabic.
ABDURRAZZAQ:v1p162/r2.anchor: وأما قوله والأرض بعد ذلك دحاها فيقول مع ذلك دحاها و مع وبعد سواء في كلام العرب

ABDURRAZZAQ:v1p162/r3.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Ṣanʿānī
ABDURRAZZAQ:v1p162/r3.speaker: ابن عباس
ABDURRAZZAQ:v1p162/r3.claim: Ibn ʿAbbas says God always was and remains with these attributes; the Qurʾan’s differing statements each convey what God intended, though people may not know it.
ABDURRAZZAQ:v1p162/r3.anchor: قال ابن عباس وأما قوله ﴿ كان الله ﴾ فإن الله كان ولم يزل كذلك

ABDURRAZZAQ:v1p162/r4.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Ṣanʿānī
ABDURRAZZAQ:v1p162/r4.speaker: عكرمة
ABDURRAZZAQ:v1p162/r4.claim: Ikrima explains that the verses describe different stations: people speak and argue at one, then God seals their mouths and their hands and feet speak, so they no longer speak.
ABDURRAZZAQ:v1p162/r4.anchor: عن قتادة قال جاء رجل إلى عكرمة فقال أرأيت قول الله تعالى ﴿ هذا يوم لا ينطقون ﴾ وقوله

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p644/r1.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p644/r1.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p644/r1.claim: The tanwīn in يومئذ compensates for an omitted preceding clause, such as God bringing witnesses from every community and Muḥammad as witness.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p644/r1.anchor: التنوين في يومئذ هو تنوين العوض، حذفت الجملة السابقة

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p644/r2.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p644/r2.speaker: قيل
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p644/r2.claim: Alternatively, the tanwīn compensates for the last preceding clause alone, that God brought Muḥammad as witness.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p644/r2.anchor: ويحتمل أن يكون التنوين عوضا من الجملة الأخيرة،

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p644/r3.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p644/r3.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p644/r3.claim: The phrase means those who disbelieved in God and disobeyed His messenger; الرسول may be generic or refer specifically to Muḥammad.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p644/r3.anchor: أي: كفروا بالله وعصوا رسوله. والرسول: هنا اسم جنس

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p644/r4.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p644/r4.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p644/r4.claim: Naming الرسول rather than saying وعصوك honors the Messenger and the divine mission, the noblest human charge and source of felicity in both lives.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p644/r4.anchor: وأبرز ظاهرا، ولم يأت وعصوك لما في ذكر الرسول

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p644/r5.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p644/r5.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p644/r5.claim: The governing verb for يوم is يود.

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p644/r6.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p644/r6.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p644/r6.claim: يود means يتمنى, to wish or desire.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p644/r6.anchor: ومعنى يود: يتمنى. وظاهر وعصوا أنه

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p644/r7.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p644/r7.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p644/r7.claim: The apparent syntax coordinates وعصوا with كفروا.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p644/r7.anchor: وظاهر وعصوا أنه معطوف على كفروا.

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p644/r8.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p644/r8.speaker: قيل
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p644/r8.claim: One alternative supplies another relative pronoun: one group disbelieved and another disobeyed the Messenger.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p644/r8.anchor: على إضمار موصول آخر أي: والذين عصوا فهما فرقتان.

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p644/r9.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p644/r9.speaker: قيل
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p644/r9.claim: Another alternative treats the واو as circumstantial: they disbelieved while having disobeyed the Messenger.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p644/r9.anchor: الواو واو الحال أي: كفروا وقد عصوا الرسول.

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p644/r10.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p644/r10.speaker: الحوفي
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p644/r10.claim: Al-Ḥawfī permits يوم to be built together with إذ because an adverb may be built when annexed to an indeclinable word.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p644/r10.anchor: وقال الحوفي: يجوز أن يكون يوم مبنيا مع إذ،

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p644/r11.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p644/r11.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p644/r11.claim: Abū Ḥayyān approves al-Ḥawfī: إذ here is a noun rather than an adverb, since annexation specifies it like a noun.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p644/r11.anchor: وإذ في هذا الموضع اسم ليست بظرف، لأن الظروف إذا

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p644/r12.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p644/r12.speaker: الجمهور
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p644/r12.claim: The majority pronounce the واو in وعصوا with ḍamma.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p644/r12.anchor: وقرأ الجمهور: وعصوا الرسول بضم الواو.

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p644/r13.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p644/r13.speaker: يحيى بن يعمر وأبو السمال
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p644/r13.claim: Yaḥyā ibn Yaʿmar and Abū al-Sammāl pronounce the واو with kasra, following the original vowel at the meeting of two vowelless letters.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p644/r13.anchor: وقرأ يحيى بن يعمر وأبو السمال: وعصوا الرسول بكسر الواو

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p644/r14.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p644/r14.speaker: ابن كثير وأبو عمرو وعاصم
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p644/r14.claim: Ibn Kathīr, Abū ʿAmr, and ʿĀṣim read تسوى with ḍamma on تاء and a light س, passive of سوى.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p644/r14.anchor: وقرأ ابن كثير، وأبو عمرو، وعاصم: تسوى بضم التاء

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p644/r15.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p644/r15.speaker: نافع وابن عامر
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p644/r15.claim: Nāfiʿ and Ibn ʿĀmir read with fatḥa on تاء and geminated س; the original تتسوى assimilates تاء into س.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p644/r15.anchor: وقرأ نافع، وابن عامر: بفتح التاء وتشديد السين

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p644/r16.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p644/r16.speaker: حمزة والكسائي
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p644/r16.claim: Ḥamza and al-Kisāʾī read with fatḥa on تاء and a light س, deleting تاء from تتسوى.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p644/r16.anchor: وقرأ حمزة والكسائي: تسوى بفتح التاء وتخفيف السين

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p644/r17.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p644/r17.speaker: أبو عبيدة وجماعة
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p644/r17.claim: For the active readings تتسوى and تسوى, the earth splits and they are inside it as it settles over them; باء means على.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p644/r17.anchor: قال أبو عبيدة وجماعة: معناه لو تنشق الأرض ويكونون فيها

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p644/r18.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p644/r18.speaker: فرقة
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p644/r18.claim: Another group understands the earth to become level with them because they become dust like beasts; the wording reverses the semantic roles.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p644/r18.anchor: وقالت فرقة: معناه لو تسوى هي معهم في أن يكونوا ترابا

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p645/r1.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p645/r1.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p645/r1.claim: On the passive reading, God carries out the leveling according to either of the two preceding interpretations.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p645/r1.anchor: وعلى قراءة من قرأ: تسوى مبنيا للمفعول، فالمعنى أن الله يفعل

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p645/r2.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p645/r2.speaker: قيل
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p645/r2.claim: Some say they wish to be buried and the earth leveled over them as over the dead, equivalent to the first interpretation.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p645/r2.anchor: وقيل: المعنى لو يدفنون فتسوى بهم الأرض كما تسوى بالموتى،

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p645/r3.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p645/r3.speaker: قيل
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p645/r3.claim: Another interpretation takes يعدل بهم الأرض as the earth’s contents being accepted in ransom for them.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p645/r3.anchor: وقيل: المعنى لو تعدل بهم الأرض أي: يؤخذ منهم ما عليها فدية.

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p645/r4.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p645/r4.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p645/r4.claim: يومئذ is governed by يود; its omitted object is estimated as the earth’s being leveled over them.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p645/r4.anchor: والعامل في يومئذ يود، ومفعول يود محذوف تقديره:

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p645/r5.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p645/r5.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p645/r5.claim: لو is conditional for something that would occur because another event occurred; its omitted answer is that they would be pleased, understood from يود.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p645/r5.anchor: ولو حرف لما كان سيقع لوقوع غيره، وجوابه محذوف

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p645/r6.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p645/r6.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p645/r6.claim: For grammarians who allow لو to be a masdariyya particle like أن, it has no answer and the clause is the object of يود.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p645/r6.anchor: ومن أجاز في لو أن تكون مصدرية مثل أن جوز ذلك هنا

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p645/r7.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p645/r7.speaker: ابن عباس
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p645/r7.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās says that, when their limbs expose them, they wish they had not hidden their association of partners with God.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p645/r7.anchor: روي عن ابن عباس أن معنى هذه: ودوا إذ فضحتهم جوارحهم

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p645/r8.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p645/r8.speaker: ابن عباس
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p645/r8.claim: Another report from Ibn ʿAbbās says that after their limbs testify, they do not conceal anything from God.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p645/r8.anchor: وروي عنه أيضا: أنهم لما شهدت عليهم جوارحهم

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p645/r9.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p645/r9.speaker: الحسن
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p645/r9.claim: Al-Ḥasan says the Resurrection has stations: in one they recognize their evil and ask to return to the world; in another they conceal and deny being polytheists.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p645/r9.anchor: وقال الحسن: القيامة مواقف، ففي موطن يعرفون سوء أعمالهم

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p645/r10.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p645/r10.speaker: الفراء والزجاج
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p645/r10.claim: Al-Farrāʾ and al-Zajjāj take this as a separate statement: they cannot conceal anything because it is manifest to God.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p645/r10.anchor: وقال الفراء والزجاج: هو كلام مستأنف لا يتعلق بقوله

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p645/r11.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p645/r11.speaker: قيل
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p645/r11.claim: Another view links the phrase to their wish: they wish the earth leveled and that they had concealed no word from God.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p645/r11.anchor: وقيل: ودوا لو سويت بهم الأرض، وأنهم لم يكتموا الله حديثا

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p645/r12.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p645/r12.speaker: ابن الأنباري
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p645/r12.claim: Ibn al-Anbārī also reports that they believed idol worship was obedience and did not consider themselves polytheists.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p645/r12.anchor: طاعة، ذكر هذين القولين: ابن الأنباري.

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p645/r13.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p645/r13.speaker: القاضي
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p645/r13.claim: The Judge says they described what they thought and imagined themselves non-polytheists, though this does not mean they were not lying.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p645/r13.anchor: قال القاضي: أخبروا بما توهموا، وكانوا يظنون أنهم ليسوا بمشركين

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p645/r14.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p645/r14.speaker: الجمهور
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p645/r14.claim: If the clause is governed by يود, the majority identify the wished-for words as their denial of polytheism, concerning the afterlife.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p645/r14.anchor: فقال الجمهور: هو قولهم والله ربنا ما كنا مشركين،

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p645/r15.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p645/r15.speaker: عطاء
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p645/r15.claim: ʿAṭāʾ instead says it concerns the Messenger’s command, description, and mission, and thus the worldly life.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p645/r15.anchor: وقال عطاء: أمر الرسول ونعته وبعثه، وهذا متعلق بالدنيا

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p646/r1.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p646/r1.speaker: ابن عباس
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p646/r1.claim: In Ibn ʿAṭiyya’s summary of Ibn ʿAbbās, they deny being polytheists, God calls them liars, and their limbs then testify against them.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p646/r1.anchor: وهذا قول ابن عباس. وقالت طائفة

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p646/r2.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p646/r2.speaker: طائفة
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p646/r2.claim: A similar view says concealment cannot help because God knows every secret; unlike the first view, it allows concealment but says it is useless.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p646/r2.anchor: وقالت طائفة مثله: إلا أنها قالت: استأنف ليخبر أن الكتم لا ينفع

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p646/r3.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p646/r3.speaker: طائفة
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p646/r3.claim: One group takes the whole clause as connected: they wish not to conceal anything, regretting their denial that they were polytheists.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p646/r3.anchor: وقالت طائفة: الكلام كله متصل، والمعنى: ويودون

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p646/r4.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p646/r4.speaker: طائفة
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p646/r4.claim: Another group explains the variation by different stations and groups on the Day of Resurrection.

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p646/r5.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p646/r5.speaker: الزمخشري
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p646/r5.claim: Al-Zamakhsharī says they cannot conceal the truth because their own limbs testify against them.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p646/r5.anchor: وقال الزمخشري: لا يقدرون على كتمانه، لأن جوارحهم تشهد عليهم

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p646/r6.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p646/r6.speaker: قيل
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p646/r6.claim: Another view treats the واو as circumstantial: they wish burial and wish not to lie when denying polytheism, since their hands and feet will testify.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p646/r6.anchor: وقيل: الواو للحال يودون أن يدفنوا تحت الأرض

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p646/r7.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p646/r7.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p646/r7.claim: The واو may introduce a circumstantial clause describing the state accompanying their wish that the earth be leveled.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p646/r7.anchor: والذي يتلخص في هذه الجملة أن الواو في قوله: ولا

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p646/r8.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p646/r8.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p646/r8.claim: The circumstantial clause can depend on بهم and تسوى if لو is masdariyya, expressing the wish that they were leveled while concealing nothing.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p646/r8.anchor: كان المعنى: أنهم يوم القيامة يودون إن كانوا ماتوا

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p646/r9.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p646/r9.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p646/r9.claim: It can instead be a state of الذين كفروا governed by يود, constraining the wish to a moment when they admit their earthly disbelief.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p646/r9.anchor: ويجوز أن يكون حالا من الذين كفروا، والعامل يود

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p646/r10.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p646/r10.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p646/r10.claim: This latter circumstantial analysis is unlikely because reports say they conceal the truth at some stations; a conditional لو also separates the state from its governor.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p646/r10.anchor: ويبعد أن يكون حالا على هذا الوجه. ولو حرف لما كان

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p646/r11.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p646/r11.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p646/r11.claim: If coordinated as individual elements, lack of concealment may be joined to the omitted object of يود: they wish for leveling and for no concealment.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p646/r11.anchor: فإن كانت من عطف المفردات كان ذلك معطوفا على مفعول يود

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p646/r12.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p646/r12.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p646/r12.claim: On that coordination, nonconcealment may mean either not hiding in this life or their afterlife denial, “By God, our Lord, we were not polytheists.”
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p646/r12.anchor: ويحتمل أن يكون انتفاء الكتمان في الدنيا، ويحتمل أن يكون

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p646/r13.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p646/r13.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p646/r13.claim: Abū Ḥayyān considers it very remote to coordinate the phrase with the omitted object of يود under a conditional لو.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p646/r13.anchor: ويبعد جدا أن يكون عطف على مفعول يود المحذوف

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p646/r14.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p646/r14.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p646/r14.claim: If the واو coordinates whole clauses, it may be joined to يود: God reports both their wish and that they do not conceal at some Resurrection stations.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p646/r14.anchor: وإن كانت من عطف الجمل فيحتمل أن يكون معطوفا على يود

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p646/r15.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p646/r15.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p646/r15.claim: Alternatively the clause may coordinate with لو and its consequence, yielding three reported clauses: wish, conditional situation, and absence of concealment.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v3p646/r15.anchor: والجملة من قوله: ولا يكتمون معطوفة على لو ومقتضيتها

ALUSI-FULL:v5p34/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v5p34/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v5p34/r1.claim: The passage resumes to explain the terrible state whose severity was just indicated.
ALUSI-FULL:v5p34/r1.anchor: استئناف لبيان حالهم التي أشير إلى شدتها وفظاعتها

ALUSI-FULL:v5p34/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v5p34/r2.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v5p34/r2.claim: The nunation of إذ may stand in place of the two preceding clauses, the first clause alone, or the last clause alone.
ALUSI-FULL:v5p34/r2.anchor: وتنوين إذ عوض على الصحيح عن الجملتين السابقتين

ALUSI-FULL:v5p34/r3.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v5p34/r3.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v5p34/r3.claim: The temporal phrase modifies يود; taking it with شهيد and making يود its adjective, with a deleted resumptive pronoun, is remote.
ALUSI-FULL:v5p34/r3.anchor: والظرف متعلق بيود وجعله متعلقا بشهيد

ALUSI-FULL:v5p34/r4.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v5p34/r4.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v5p34/r4.claim: The relative may refer specifically to those who denied the Messenger; the wording rebukes them and marks the cause of their dreadful state.
ALUSI-FULL:v5p34/r4.anchor: والتعبير عنهم بذلك لذمهم بما في حيز الصلة

ALUSI-FULL:v5p34/r5.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v5p34/r5.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v5p34/r5.claim: Calling Muhammad the Messenger honors him and further condemns those who deny him.
ALUSI-FULL:v5p34/r5.anchor: وإيراده صلى الله تعالى عليه وسلم بعنوان الرسالة لتشريفه وزيادة تقبيح حال مكذبيه

ALUSI-FULL:v5p34/r6.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v5p34/r6.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v5p34/r6.claim: Alternatively, the phrase means disbelievers generally, especially those who denied the Prophet; رسول is also generic but chiefly includes Muhammad.
ALUSI-FULL:v5p34/r6.anchor: وإما جنس الكفرة ويدخل أولئك في زمرتهم دخولا أوليا

ALUSI-FULL:v5p34/r7.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v5p34/r7.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v5p34/r7.claim: عصوا is coordinated with كفروا within the relative clause and refers to disobedience beyond disbelief, implying that disbelievers are accountable for derivative duties.
ALUSI-FULL:v5p34/r7.anchor: داخل معه في حيز الصلة والمراد عصيانهم بما سوى الكفر

ALUSI-FULL:v5p34/r8.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v5p34/r8.speaker: أبو البقاء
ALUSI-FULL:v5p34/r8.claim: Abu al-Baqa instead parses عصوا as a circumstantial clause attached to the subject of كفروا, with قد understood.
ALUSI-FULL:v5p34/r8.anchor: وقال أبو البقاء : إنه في موضع الحال من ضمير ( كفروا )

ALUSI-FULL:v5p34/r9.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v5p34/r9.speaker: الفراء
ALUSI-FULL:v5p34/r9.claim: Another analysis treats this as two coordinated relatives, describing two groups, which works on al-Farra's view that a relative pronoun can be elided.
ALUSI-FULL:v5p34/r9.anchor: وقيل : صلة لموصول آخر أي والذين عصوا

ALUSI-FULL:v5p34/r10.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v5p34/r10.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v5p34/r10.claim: On that day, the people described from their worldly state wish for this because the day brings added severity and doubled terror.
ALUSI-FULL:v5p34/r10.anchor: أي يود في ذلك اليوم لمزيد شدته ومضاعف هوله الموصوفون بما ذكر في الدنيا

ALUSI-FULL:v5p34/r11.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v5p34/r11.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v5p34/r11.claim: One syntax makes the لو clause the object of يود, with لو meaning that; they wish to be buried and the earth leveled over them like the dead.
ALUSI-FULL:v5p34/r11.anchor: إما مفعول ( يود ) على أن ( لو ) مصدرية أي يودون أن يدفنوا

ALUSI-FULL:v5p34/r12.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v5p34/r12.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v5p34/r12.claim: One explanation is that they wish they had remained dust as they originally were, never created.
ALUSI-FULL:v5p34/r12.anchor: وقيل : يودون أنهم بقوا ترابا على أصلهم من غير خلق

ALUSI-FULL:v5p34/r13.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v5p34/r13.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v5p34/r13.claim: Another explanation is that animals become dust and the unbelievers wish they shared that fate.
ALUSI-FULL:v5p34/r13.anchor: وقيل : تصير البهائم ترابا فيودون حالها

ALUSI-FULL:v5p34/r14.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v5p34/r14.speaker: ابن عباس
ALUSI-FULL:v5p34/r14.claim: Ibn Abbas says they wish the gathered people would walk over them, treading them as they tread the ground.
ALUSI-FULL:v5p34/r14.anchor: وعن ابن عباس أن المعنى يودون أن يمشى عليهم أهل الجمع يطأونهم بأقدامهم

ALUSI-FULL:v5p34/r15.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v5p34/r15.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v5p34/r15.claim: Another view takes the phrase as wishing to be exchanged for the earth, giving everything on it as ransom.
ALUSI-FULL:v5p34/r15.anchor: وقيل : يودون لو يعدل بهم الأرض أي يؤخذ منهم ما عليها فدية

ALUSI-FULL:v5p34/r16.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v5p34/r16.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v5p34/r16.claim: Alternatively, لو retains its usual conditional sense; يود has an omitted object and the conditional answer is also omitted, understood from the context.
ALUSI-FULL:v5p34/r16.anchor: وإما مستأنفة على أن ( لو ) على بابها ومفعول ( يود ) محذوف

ALUSI-FULL:v5p34/r17.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v5p34/r17.speaker: نافع وابن عامر ويزيد
ALUSI-FULL:v5p34/r17.claim: Nafi, Ibn Amir, and Yazid read تسوى as تتسوى with the first ta assimilated into the nearby sin.
ALUSI-FULL:v5p34/r17.anchor: وقرأ نافع وابن عامر ويزيد ( تسوى ) على أن أصله تتسوى

ALUSI-FULL:v5p34/r18.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v5p34/r18.speaker: حمزة والكسائي
ALUSI-FULL:v5p34/r18.claim: Hamza and al-Kisai read تسوى by dropping the second ta and applying imala.
ALUSI-FULL:v5p34/r18.anchor: وحمزة والكسائي ( تسوى ) بحذف التاء الثانية مع الإمالة

ALUSI-FULL:v5p35/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v5p35/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v5p35/r1.claim: They may be unable to conceal anything because their limbs testify against them; or they admit all their deeds, knowing concealment will not help, despite saying at some points that they were not polytheists.
ALUSI-FULL:v5p35/r1.anchor: لا يكتمون من الله تعالى حديثا لعدم قدرتهم على الكتمان حيث أن جوارحهم تشهد عليهم

ALUSI-FULL:v5p35/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v5p35/r2.speaker: الحسن
ALUSI-FULL:v5p35/r2.claim: Al-Hasan explains that they confess because they know concealment cannot benefit them, though in some situations they say they were not polytheists.
ALUSI-FULL:v5p35/r2.anchor: وإنما لا يكتمون لعلمهم بأنهم لا ينفعهم الكتمان وإنما يقولون : ( والله ربنا ما كنا مشركين )

ALUSI-FULL:v5p35/r3.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v5p35/r3.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v5p35/r3.claim: Alternatively, the waw is circumstantial: they wish to be buried while not concealing anything or denying the truth with the claim that they were not polytheists.
ALUSI-FULL:v5p35/r3.anchor: وقيل : الواو للحال أي يودون أن يدفنوا في الأرض وهم لا يكتمون

ALUSI-FULL:v5p35/r4.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v5p35/r4.speaker: ابن عباس
ALUSI-FULL:v5p35/r4.claim: Al-Hakim, whose report al-Alusi says is authentic, transmits from Ibn Abbas that after they deny being polytheists, God seals their mouths and their limbs testify, making them wish the earth were leveled over them.
ALUSI-FULL:v5p35/r4.anchor: إذ روى الحاكم وصححه عن ابن عباس رضي الله تعالى عنهما أنهم إذا قالوا ذلك ختم الله على أفواههم

ALUSI-FULL:v5p35/r5.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v5p35/r5.speaker: عطاء
ALUSI-FULL:v5p35/r5.claim: Attribution of what follows to تسوى is judged very remote: the wish would be that they had not concealed Muhammad and his sending in worldly life.
ALUSI-FULL:v5p35/r5.anchor: وجعلها للعطف وما بعدها معطوف على ( تسوى ) على معنى يودون لو تسوى

ALUSI-FULL:v5p35/r6.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v5p35/r6.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v5p35/r6.claim: Al-Alusi calls that coordination very remote; a closer analysis coordinates non-concealment with the object of يود, expressing a wish for the earth's leveling and for their having concealed nothing.
ALUSI-FULL:v5p35/r6.anchor: بعيد جدا وأقرب منه العطف على مفعول ( يود ) على معنى يودون تسوية الأرض بهم

ALUSI-FULL:v5p35/r7.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v5p35/r7.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v5p35/r7.claim: The alternative coordination is understood against their statement that they were not polytheists.
ALUSI-FULL:v5p35/r7.anchor: إذ قالوا ( والله ربنا ما كنا مشركين )

ALUSI-FULL:v5p37/r27.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v5p37/r27.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v5p37/r27.claim: Those who disbelieve are people veiled from God, and their disobedience to the Messenger is failure to follow him.
ALUSI-FULL:v5p37/r27.anchor: ( يود الذين كفروا ) بالاحتجاب ( وعصوا الرسول ) بعدم المتابعة

ALUSI-FULL:v5p37/r28.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v5p37/r28.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v5p37/r28.claim: They wish their souls could be effaced or made blank, without the imprint of corrupt beliefs and destructive vices.
ALUSI-FULL:v5p37/r28.anchor: لتنطمس نفوسهم أو تصير ساذجة لا نقش فيها من العقائد الفاسدة والرذائل الموبقة

ALUSI-FULL:v5p37/r29.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v5p37/r29.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v5p37/r29.claim: They cannot conceal any imprint of those beliefs and vices; nothing can be hidden once everything is exposed.
ALUSI-FULL:v5p37/r29.anchor: أي لا يقدرون على كتم حديث من تلك النقوش وهيهات أنى يخفون شيئا منها

BAGHAWI-FULL:v2p217#2/r1.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v2p217#2/r1.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v2p217#2/r1.claim: يومئذ means on the Day of Resurrection.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v2p217#2/r1.anchor: قوله عز وجل: {يومئذ} أي يوم القيامة،

BAGHAWI-FULL:v2p217#2/r2.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v2p217#2/r2.speaker: أهل المدينة وابن عامر وحمزة والكسائي والباقون
BAGHAWI-FULL:v2p217#2/r2.claim: Medina and Ibn ʿĀmir read with open tāʾ and doubled sīn, assimilating a second tāʾ; Ḥamza and al-Kisāʾī use open tāʾ and light sīn, like 11:105; the rest use passive with ḍamma, meaning earth made level with them.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v2p217#2/r2.anchor: وقرأ حمزة والكسائي بفتح التاء وتخفيف السين على حذف تاء التفعل كقوله تعالى

BAGHAWI-FULL:v2p217#2/r3.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v2p217#2/r3.speaker: قتادة وأبو عبيدة
BAGHAWI-FULL:v2p217#2/r3.claim: Qatāda and Abū ʿUbayda say they wish the earth would split, swallow them, and then be leveled over them.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v2p217#2/r3.anchor: وقال قتادة وأبو عبيدة: يعني لو تخرقت الأرض فساخوا فيها وعادوا إليها ثم تسوى بهم،

BAGHAWI-FULL:v2p217#2/r4.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v2p217#2/r4.speaker: قيل
BAGHAWI-FULL:v2p217#2/r4.claim: Another view says they wish they had never been resurrected, since they came from earth and had been covered by it.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v2p217#2/r4.anchor: وقيل: ودوا لو أنهم لم يبعثوا لأنهم إنما نقلوا من التراب، وكانت الأرض مستوية عليهم.

BAGHAWI-FULL:v2p217#2/r5.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v2p217#2/r5.speaker: الكلبي
BAGHAWI-FULL:v2p217#2/r5.claim: Al-Kalbī says God will turn beasts and birds to dust, flatten earth over them, and the unbeliever will wish he too had become dust, as in 78:40.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v2p217#2/r5.anchor: وقال الكلبي: يقول الله عز وجل للبهائم والوحوش والطير والسباع: كونوا ترابا

BAGHAWI-FULL:v2p218/r1.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v2p218/r1.speaker: عطاء
BAGHAWI-FULL:v2p218/r1.claim: ʿAṭāʾ says they will wish the earth covered them and that they had not concealed Muhammad's status and description.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v2p218/r1.anchor: قال عطاء: ودوا لو تسوى بهم الأرض وأنهم لم يكونوا كتموا أمر محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم ولا نعته.

BAGHAWI-FULL:v2p218/r2.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v2p218/r2.speaker: الآخرون
BAGHAWI-FULL:v2p218/r2.claim: Others take this as a new sentence: they cannot conceal anything from God because their deeds are known to Him.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v2p218/r2.anchor: وقال الآخرون: بل هو كلام مستأنف، يعني: ولا يكتمون الله حديثا لأن ما عملوا لا يخفى على الله

BAGHAWI-FULL:v2p218/r3.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v2p218/r3.speaker: الكلبي وجماعة
BAGHAWI-FULL:v2p218/r3.claim: Al-Kalbī and others say they cannot conceal anything because their bodily limbs testify against them.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v2p218/r3.anchor: وقال الكلبي وجماعة: {ولا يكتمون الله حديثا} لأن جوارحهم تشهد عليهم.

BAGHAWI-FULL:v2p218/r4.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v2p218/r4.speaker: ابن عباس
BAGHAWI-FULL:v2p218/r4.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās reconciles no kinship and no questioning with later mutual questioning: the former occurs after the first trumpet blast, the latter after the second.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v2p218/r4.anchor: فقال ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما: فلا أنساب بينهم في النفخة الأولى

BAGHAWI-FULL:v2p218/r5.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v2p218/r5.speaker: ابن عباس
BAGHAWI-FULL:v2p218/r5.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās says the deniers first claim they were not polytheists, but sealed mouths and speaking limbs expose them, so they cannot hide anything.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v2p218/r5.anchor: فقال ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما

BAGHAWI-FULL:v2p218/r6.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v2p218/r6.speaker: ابن عباس
BAGHAWI-FULL:v2p218/r6.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās reconciles creation accounts: earth was created in two days, its provisions and features completed over four, and the heavens in two more.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v2p218/r6.anchor: فقال ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما

BAGHAWI-FULL:v2p218/r7.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v2p218/r7.speaker: ابن عباس
BAGHAWI-FULL:v2p218/r7.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās explains descriptions such as God being forgiving and merciful as always true of Him, not attributes that began and then passed away.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v2p218/r7.anchor: فقال ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما

BAGHAWI-FULL:v2p218#2/r1.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v2p218#2/r1.speaker: الحسن
BAGHAWI-FULL:v2p218#2/r1.claim: Al-Ḥasan says the apparent contrasts concern different scenes: people sometimes fall silent or whisper, sometimes speak or lie, confess, ask for return, or stop concealing when their mouths are sealed and limbs testify.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v2p218#2/r1.anchor: وقال الحسن: إنها مواطن، ففي موطن لا يتكلمون ولا تسمع إلا همسا، وفي موطن يتكلمون ويكذبون

BAYDAWI-FULL:4:41-42/r5.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:4:41-42/r5.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:4:41-42/r5.claim: The phrase may identify people combining disbelief and disobedience, or separately name disbelievers and disobedient people.
BAYDAWI-FULL:4:41-42/r5.anchor: أي يود الذين جمعوا بين الكفر وعصيان الأمر، أو الكفرة والعصاة

BAYDAWI-FULL:4:41-42/r6.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:4:41-42/r6.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:4:41-42/r6.claim: They wish they could be buried with earth flat over them like the dead, or that they had never been resurrected, created, or distinguished from earth.
BAYDAWI-FULL:4:41-42/r6.anchor: أن يدفنوا فتسوى بهم الأرض كالموتى، أو لم يبعثوا أو لم يخلقوا

BAYDAWI-FULL:4:41-42/r7.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:4:41-42/r7.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:4:41-42/r7.claim: They cannot conceal anything from God because their limbs testify against them.
BAYDAWI-FULL:4:41-42/r7.anchor: ولا يقدرون على كتمانه لأن جوارحهم تشهد عليهم.

BAYDAWI-FULL:4:41-42/r8.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:4:41-42/r8.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:4:41-42/r8.claim: Alternatively, wāw is circumstantial: they wish the earth would cover them while unable to hide anything or deny God by claiming they were never polytheists.
BAYDAWI-FULL:4:41-42/r8.anchor: وقيل الواو للحال أي يودون أن تسوى بهم الأرض وحالهم أنهم

BAYDAWI-FULL:4:41-42/r9.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:4:41-42/r9.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:4:41-42/r9.claim: A report says that after their mouths are sealed, their limbs testify, the ordeal intensifies, and they wish the earth would cover them.
BAYDAWI-FULL:4:41-42/r9.anchor: إذ روي: أنهم إذا قالوا ختم الله على أفواههم فتشهد عليهم جوارحهم

BAYDAWI-FULL:4:41-42/r10.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:4:41-42/r10.speaker: نافع وابن عامر
BAYDAWI-FULL:4:41-42/r10.claim: Nāfiʿ and Ibn ʿĀmir read tasawwā, assimilating the first tāʾ into the sīn.
BAYDAWI-FULL:4:41-42/r10.anchor: وقرأ نافع وابن عامر { تسوى بهم } على أن أصله تتسوى

BAYDAWI-FULL:4:41-42/r11.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:4:41-42/r11.speaker: حمزة والكسائي
BAYDAWI-FULL:4:41-42/r11.claim: Ḥamza and al-Kisāʾī read taswā by deleting the second tāʾ, from sawwaytuhu fa-tasawwā.
BAYDAWI-FULL:4:41-42/r11.anchor: وقرأ حمزة والكسائي { تسوى } على حذف التاء الثانية

BIQAI-FULL:v2p258#2/r2.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v2p258#2/r2.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v2p258#2/r2.claim: When witnesses stand, unbelievers will wish the earth leveled over them, burying them with no unevenness; they dread the shame of rebuke and punishment to come.
BIQAI-FULL:v2p258#2/r2.anchor: ولا تكون كذلك إلا وقد غيبتهم واستوت بهم

BIQAI-FULL:v2p258#2/r3.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v2p258#2/r3.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v2p258#2/r3.claim: They will not be able to hide anything from God but will be exposed by their evil accounts and carry all their burdens, requited for concealing His signs and proofs in life.
BIQAI-FULL:v2p258#2/r3.anchor: بل يفتضحون بسيء أخبارهم , ويحملون جميع أوزارهم

BIQAI-FULL:v2p258#2/r4.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v2p258#2/r4.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v2p258#2/r4.claim: The terrifying judgment scene makes sinners wish for nonexistence and prevents concealment; because salvation requires purity through faith and obedience, the discussion turns to worldly prayer and purification.
BIQAI-FULL:v2p258#2/r4.anchor: لا ينجو فيه إلا من كان طاهر القلب والجوارح

BURSEVI:v2p166/r5.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v2p166/r5.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v2p166/r5.claim: The next verse describes the dreadful state introduced by the question how they will fare; disobedience here means sins beyond disbelief, avoiding a redundant conjunction.
BURSEVI:v2p166/r5.anchor: وعصيان الرسول محمول على المعاصي المغايرة للكفر فلا يلزم عطف الشيء على نفسه

BURSEVI:v2p166/r6.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v2p166/r6.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v2p166/r6.claim: The wording can refer separately to those who disbelieved and those who disobeyed the Messenger.
BURSEVI:v2p166/r6.anchor: أي يتمنى الذين جمعوا بين الكفر وعصيان الرسول والمراد الذين كفروا والذين عصوا الرسول

BURSEVI:v2p166/r7.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v2p166/r7.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v2p166/r7.claim: Here law introduces a verbal noun clause serving as the object of they wish: they wish to be buried and leveled with the earth, or never to have been raised or created.
BURSEVI:v2p166/r7.anchor: لو بمعنى أن المصدرية والجملة مفعول يود أي يودون أن يدفنوا فتسوي بهم الأرض كالموتى

BURSEVI:v2p166/r8.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v2p166/r8.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v2p166/r8.claim: A second explanation is that they wish they had not been resurrected or created and were simply equal to the earth.
BURSEVI:v2p166/r8.anchor: أو يودون أنهم لم يبعثوا ولم يخلقوا وكأنهم والأرض سواء

BURSEVI:v2p166/r9.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v2p166/r9.speaker: بعض الأفاضل
BURSEVI:v2p166/r9.claim: A scholar takes bi as accompaniment: the earth is leveled while they lie with it; this avoids reversing the construction, with little difference in sense.
BURSEVI:v2p166/r9.anchor: الأفاضل الباء للملابسة أي تسوى الأرض ملتبسة بهم ولا حاجة إلى الحمل على القلب لقلة الفرق

BURSEVI:v2p166/r10.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v2p166/r10.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v2p166/r10.claim: If coordinated with they wish, the clause means they cannot conceal the truth because their limbs testify against them.
BURSEVI:v2p166/r10.anchor: عطف على يود أي : ولا يقدرون على كتمانه لأن جوارحهم تشهد عليهم

BURSEVI:v2p166/r11.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v2p166/r11.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v2p166/r11.claim: Alternatively, the conjunction is circumstantial: they wish to be buried while unable to conceal anything from God or deny their shirk.
BURSEVI:v2p166/r11.anchor: أو الواو للحال أي يودون أن يدفنوا في الأرض وهم لا يكتمون منه تعالى حديثا ولا يكذبونه بقولهم والله ربنا ما كنا مشركين

BURSEVI:v2p166/r12.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v2p166/r12.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v2p166/r12.claim: A report says that when they deny being polytheists, God seals their mouths and their limbs testify, intensifying their distress until they wish the earth would cover them.
BURSEVI:v2p166/r12.anchor: إذ روى أنهم إذا قالوا ذلك ختم الله على أفواههم فتشهد عليهم جوارحهم فيشتد الأمر عليهم فيتمنون أن تسوى بهم الأرض

DURR-FULL:v2p541/r6.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v2p541/r6.speaker: ابن عباس
DURR-FULL:v2p541/r6.claim: Ibn Abbas interprets the wish that the earth be leveled over the disbelievers as the ground and mountains being made level over them.
DURR-FULL:v2p541/r6.anchor: عن ابن عباس في قوله {لو تسوى بهم الأرض} يعني أن تستوي الأرض الجبال عليهم

DURR-FULL:v2p541/r7.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v2p541/r7.speaker: قتادة
DURR-FULL:v2p541/r7.claim: Qatada says the disbelievers wish the earth would split open and swallow them.
DURR-FULL:v2p541/r7.anchor: عن قتادة في الآية يقول: ودوا لو انخرقت بهم الأرض فساخوا فيها

DURR-FULL:v2p541/r8.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v2p541/r8.speaker: ابن جريج
DURR-FULL:v2p541/r8.claim: Ibn Jurayj explains that the earth splits for them, they enter it, and it closes and levels over them.
DURR-FULL:v2p541/r8.anchor: عن ابن جريج {لو تسوى بهم الأرض} تنشق لهم فيدخلون فيها فتسوي عليهم

DURR-FULL:v2p543/r1.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v2p543/r1.speaker: ابن عباس
DURR-FULL:v2p543/r1.claim: Ibn Abbas reconciles 4:42 with 6:23: disbelievers first deny associating partners in hope of forgiveness, but God seals their mouths and their limbs testify, so they wish to vanish and cannot conceal the truth.
DURR-FULL:v2p543/r1.anchor: فقال ابن عباس: أما قوله (ثم لم تكن فتنتهم إلا أن قالوا والله ربنا ما كنا مشركين)

DURR-FULL:v2p543/r2.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v2p543/r2.speaker: ابن عباس
DURR-FULL:v2p543/r2.claim: Ibn Abbas says kinship and questioning cease at the first trumpet blast, but after the second blast people rise and question one another.
DURR-FULL:v2p543/r2.anchor: وأما قوله (فلا أنساب بينهم يومئذ ولا يتساءلون) (المؤمنون الآية 101) فهذا في النفخة الأولى

DURR-FULL:v2p543/r3.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v2p543/r3.speaker: ابن عباس
DURR-FULL:v2p543/r3.claim: Ibn Abbas reconciles creation passages by saying the earth was created before the heavens, which were smoke, and the seven heavens were fashioned afterward.
DURR-FULL:v2p543/r3.anchor: وأما قوله (خلق الأرض في يومين) (فصلت الآية 9) فإن الأرض خلقت قبل

DURR-FULL:v2p544/r1.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v2p544/r1.speaker: ابن عباس
DURR-FULL:v2p544/r1.claim: Ibn Abbas explains that the later spreading of the earth means placing mountains, rivers, trees, and seas in it after its creation.
DURR-FULL:v2p544/r1.anchor: وأما قوله (والأرض بعد ذلك دحاها) (النازعات الآية 6) يقول: جعل فيها جبلا جعل فيها نهرا

DURR-FULL:v2p544/r3.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v2p544/r3.speaker: ابن عباس
DURR-FULL:v2p544/r3.claim: Ibn Abbas says apparent differences among Quran passages resemble these explanations: every revealed statement achieves what God intended, though most people do not know.
DURR-FULL:v2p544/r3.anchor: فما اختلف عليك من القرآن فهو يشبه ما ذكرت لك وأن الله لم ينزل شيئا إلا وقد أصاب به الذي أراد

DURR-FULL:v2p544/r4.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v2p544/r4.speaker: ابن عباس
DURR-FULL:v2p544/r4.claim: Ibn Abbas tells Nafi ibn al-Azraq that on Judgment Day people gather in one plain; polytheists deny their shirk, but their limbs testify, and they then wish the earth were leveled over them.
DURR-FULL:v2p544/r4.anchor: عن الضحاك أن نافع بن الأزرق أتى ابن عباس فقال: يا ابن عباس قول الله

DURR-FULL:v2p544/r5.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v2p544/r5.speaker: حذيفة
DURR-FULL:v2p544/r5.claim: Hudhayfa reports that a wealthy man admitted only giving debtors more time; God declared Himself more entitled to such mercy and forgave the servant. Abu Masud says he heard this from the Prophet.
DURR-FULL:v2p544/r5.anchor: عن حذيفة قال: أتي بعبد آتاه الله مالا فقال له: ماذا عملت في الدنيا

DURR-FULL:v2p544/r6.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v2p544/r6.speaker: ابن عباس
DURR-FULL:v2p544/r6.claim: Ibn Abbas explains that they cannot conceal the truth with their limbs.
DURR-FULL:v2p544/r6.anchor: عن ابن عباس {ولا يكتمون الله حديثا} قال: بجوارحهم

IBNABIHATIM:v3p957/r1.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v3p957/r1.speaker: مسلم البطين
IBNABIHATIM:v3p957/r1.claim: Muslim al-Batin identifies those who wish to be leveled with the earth as the disbelievers.
IBNABIHATIM:v3p957/r1.anchor: عن هاشم بن البريد ، عن مسلم البطين قوله : لو تسوى بهم الأرض قال : الذين كفروا

IBNABIHATIM:v3p957/r2.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v3p957/r2.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNABIHATIM:v3p957/r2.claim: Ibn Abbas says the disbelievers wish the earth were leveled over them, with the mountains and ground covering them.
IBNABIHATIM:v3p957/r2.anchor: عن ابن عباس قوله : يومئذ يود الذين كفروا وعصوا الرسول لو تسوى بهم الأرض يعني : ان تسوى

IBNABIHATIM:v3p957/r3.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v3p957/r3.speaker: قتادة
IBNABIHATIM:v3p957/r3.claim: Qatada explains that they wish the earth would split open and swallow them, so they could not conceal anything from God.
IBNABIHATIM:v3p957/r3.anchor: عن قتادة قوله : يومئذ يود الذين كفروا وعصوا الرسول لو تسوى بهم الأرض يقول : ودوا لو انخرقت الأرض

IBNABIHATIM:v3p957/r4.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v3p957/r4.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNABIHATIM:v3p957/r4.claim: Ibn Abbas relates that when people think only those who prayed will enter Paradise, others deny their deeds; their mouths are sealed and their limbs testify, leaving them unable to hide anything.
IBNABIHATIM:v3p957/r4.anchor: عن ابن عباس قال : اتاه رجل فقال : يا أبا عباس : فانهم اذا راوا انه لا يدخل الجنة الا اهل الصلاة

IBNABIHATIM:v3p957/r5.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v3p957/r5.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
IBNABIHATIM:v3p957/r5.claim: Hudhayfa recounts a servant who used his wealth to trade leniently, ease wealthy debtors, and defer the poor; God ordered that he be forgiven. Uqba ibn Amir or Abu Masud says they heard this from the Prophet.
IBNABIHATIM:v3p957/r5.anchor: عن ربعي بن حراش ، عن حذيفة قال : اتى الله بعبد من عباده اتاه الله مالا ، فقال له : ماذا عملت في الدنيا

IBNABIHATIM:v3p957/r6.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v3p957/r6.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNABIHATIM:v3p957/r6.claim: Ibn Abbas explains that they cannot conceal anything from God by means of their limbs.
IBNABIHATIM:v3p957/r6.anchor: عن ابن عباس في قوله : ولا يكتمون الله حديثا قال : بجوارحهم

IBNASHUR-FULL:v5p58#2/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v5p58#2/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v5p58#2/r1.claim: The sentence is a clarifying restart: it answers the listener’s question about the strange situation raised by “how?” by showing the disbelievers’ terror when witnesses’ testimony and punishment become clear.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v5p58#2/r1.anchor: الآية استئناف بياني ، لأن السامع يتساءل عن الحالة المبهمة

IBNASHUR-FULL:v5p58#2/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v5p58#2/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v5p58#2/r2.claim: The conditional clause explains what they wish for; its content functions like the object of “yود,” with “law” functioning as a nominalizing particle.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v5p58#2/r2.anchor: وجملة { لو تسوى بهم الأرض } بيان لجملة يود أي يودون ودا

IBNASHUR-FULL:v5p58#2/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v5p58#2/r3.speaker: نافع وابن عامر وأبو جعفر
IBNASHUR-FULL:v5p58#2/r3.claim: These readers pronounce the tāʾ open and the sīn doubled: the form is the imperfect of tasawwā, the passive counterpart of making something equal, with two tāʾs assimilated.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v5p58#2/r3.anchor: قرأه نافع ، وابن عامر ، وأبو جعفر بفتح التاء وتشديد السين

IBNASHUR-FULL:v5p58#2/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v5p58#2/r4.speaker: حمزة والكسائي وخلف
IBNASHUR-FULL:v5p58#2/r4.claim: These readers use an open tāʾ and undoubled sīn, retaining the same meaning as the previous reading while deleting one tāʾ for ease.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v5p58#2/r4.anchor: وقرأه حمزة ، والكسائي ، وخلف بفتح التاء وتخفيف السين

IBNASHUR-FULL:v5p58#2/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v5p58#2/r5.speaker: ابن كثير وابن عامر وأبو عمرو ويعقوب
IBNASHUR-FULL:v5p58#2/r5.claim: These readers use a damma on the tāʾ and a light sīn, making the verb passive: the earth would be made equal with them.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v5p58#2/r5.anchor: وقرأه ابن كثير ، وابن عامر ، وأبو عمرو ، ويعقوب { تسوى } بضم التاء

IBNASHUR-FULL:v5p58#2/r6.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v5p58#2/r6.speaker: الجمهور
IBNASHUR-FULL:v5p58#2/r6.claim: The majority understand the wish as becoming earth themselves; the wording elaborates by indirect allusion to their becoming dust, like 78:40.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v5p58#2/r6.anchor: وهذا تفسير الجمهور ، وعلى هذا فالكلام إطناب

IBNASHUR-FULL:v5p59/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v5p59/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v5p59/r1.claim: Ziyad al-Aʿjam’s line about generosity, manliness, and giving being beneath Ibn al-Ḥashraj’s tent illustrates an indirect attribution of those virtues to the person.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v5p59/r1.anchor: إن السماحة والمروءة والندى في قبة ضربت على ابن الحشرج

IBNASHUR-FULL:v5p59/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v5p59/r2.speaker: قيل
IBNASHUR-FULL:v5p59/r2.claim: One proposed interpretation is that they wish not to be resurrected, remaining level with the earth inside it.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v5p59/r2.anchor: فقيل : يودون أنهم لم يبعثوا وبقوا مستوين مع الأرض في بطنها

IBNASHUR-FULL:v5p59/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v5p59/r3.speaker: قيل
IBNASHUR-FULL:v5p59/r3.claim: Another proposed interpretation is that they wish to be buried again, as they had been before resurrection.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v5p59/r3.anchor: وقيل : يودون أن يدفنوا حينئذ كما كانوا قبل البعث

IBNASHUR-FULL:v5p59/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v5p59/r4.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v5p59/r4.claim: The preferred sense is that the earth rise to the same level as their bodies, hiding them; this conveys their terror and humiliation as they shrink from view.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v5p59/r4.anchor: والأظهر عندي : أن المعنى التسوية في البروز والظهور

IBNASHUR-FULL:v5p59/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v5p59/r5.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v5p59/r5.claim: This interpretation best fits the indirect allusion; a Bedouin’s satire of Tayyiʾ, as quoted by al-Mubarrad, pictures people becoming indistinguishable.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v5p59/r5.anchor: وهذا أحسن في معنى الآية وأنسب بالكناية

IBNASHUR-FULL:v5p59/r6.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v5p59/r6.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v5p59/r6.claim: The clause may be an independent sentence coordinated with “they wish,” sharing its subject.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v5p59/r6.anchor: والواو عاطفة لها على جملة { يود }

IBNASHUR-FULL:v5p59/r7.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v5p59/r7.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v5p59/r7.claim: Alternatively, it is a circumstantial clause: they wish the earth would cover them while they are unable to conceal anything from God.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v5p59/r7.anchor: ويجوز أن تكون حالية ، أي يودون لو تسوى بهم الأرض

IBNASHUR-FULL:v5p59/r8.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v5p59/r8.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v5p59/r8.claim: After seeing earlier nations’ witnesses and consequences, they expect their own turn and want to hide; they can neither confess the ruinous truth nor risk concealment, so they wish to disappear.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v5p59/r8.anchor: علموا أن النوبة مفضية إليهم ، وخامرهم أن يكتموا الله أمرهم

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p55#2/r5.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p55#2/r5.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p55#2/r5.claim: يومئذ may be parsed as an adverbial accusative, with إذ inflected alongside indeclinable nouns, or as built on the accusative with such nouns.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p55#2/r5.anchor: ويومئذ ظرف ويصح أن يكون نصب «يوم» في هذا الموضع على الظرف،

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p55#2/r6.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p55#2/r6.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p55#2/r6.claim: The wish occurs on that very day.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p55#2/r6.anchor: و «الود» إنما هو في ذلك اليوم،

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p55#2/r7.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p55#2/r7.speaker: نافع وابن عامر
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p55#2/r7.claim: Nāfiʿ and Ibn ʿĀmir read تسوى with doubled sīn and wāw, assimilating the second tāʾ of تتسوى.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p55#2/r7.anchor: وقرأ نافع وابن عامر «تسوى» بتشديد السين والواو على إدغام التاء الثانية من تتسوى،

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p55#2/r8.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p55#2/r8.speaker: حمزة والكسائي
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p55#2/r8.claim: Ḥamza and al-Kisāʾī read تسوى with a light sīn and doubled wāw, deleting the second tāʾ; the readings mean the same.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p55#2/r8.anchor: وقرأ حمزة والكسائي «تسوى» بتخفيف السين وتشديد الواو، على حذف التاء الثانية المذكورة،

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p55#2/r9.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p55#2/r9.speaker: فرقة
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p55#2/r9.claim: One group says the earth splits, they enter it, and it then levels itself over and around them.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p55#2/r9.anchor: فقالت فرقة: تنشق الأرض فيحصلون فيها ثم تتسوى هي في نفسها عليهم وبهم،

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p55#2/r10.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p55#2/r10.speaker: فرقة
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p55#2/r10.claim: Another group understands the wish as becoming level with the earth, turning to dust like their ancestors.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p55#2/r10.anchor: وقالت فرقة: معناه لو تستوي هي معهم في أن يكونوا ترابا كآبائهم،

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p55#2/r11.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p55#2/r11.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p55#2/r11.claim: In the second interpretation, wording reverses the relation: the earth is said to become level with them though the meaning is that they become level with the earth, as in usages cited by Sībawayh.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p55#2/r11.anchor: فجاء اللفظ على أن الأرض هي المستوية معهم، والمعنى إنما هو أنهم يستوون مع الأرض،

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p55#2/r12.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p55#2/r12.speaker: ابن كثير وابن عامر وأبو عمرو
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p55#2/r12.claim: Ibn Kathīr, Ibn ʿĀmir, and Abū ʿAmr read تسوى as passive with its agent unexpressed; God brings about either described outcome.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p55#2/r12.anchor: وقرأ ابن كثير وابن عامر وأبو عمرو «تسوى» على بناء الفعل للمفعول الذي لم يسم فاعله،

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p55#2/r13.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p55#2/r13.speaker: أبو علي
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p55#2/r13.claim: Abū ʿAlī says imāla of fatḥa toward kasra and alif toward yāʾ in تسوى is a good pronunciation.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p55#2/r13.anchor: قال أبو علي: إمالة الفتحة إلى الكسرة والألف إلى الياء في «تسوى» حسنة،

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p55#2/r14.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p55#2/r14.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p55#2/r14.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās says unbelievers first wish the earth would cover them to escape the terrors; their limbs then testify after they deny being idolaters (6:23).
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p55#2/r14.anchor: وهذا قول ابن عباس، وقال فيه: إن الله إذا جمع الأولين والآخرين ظن بعض الكفار أن الإنكار ينجي،

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p56/r1.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p56/r1.speaker: طائفة
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p56/r1.claim: A group agrees that the earth wish concerns the terrors, then treats the next clause as saying concealment is useless because God knows their secrets and reports.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p56/r1.anchor: وقالت طائفة: مثل القول الأول، إلا أنها قالت: إنما استأنف الكلام بقوله: ولا يكتمون الله حديثا ليخبر عن أن الكتم لا ينفع،

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p56/r2.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p56/r2.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p56/r2.claim: Ibn ʿAṭiyya distinguishes this from Ibn ʿAbbās: one says concealment fails in every way, while the other says this setting offers no benefit whether concealment occurs or not.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p56/r2.anchor: قال القاضي أبو محمد: الفرق بين هذين القولين أن الأول يقتضي أن الكتم لا ينفع بوجه،

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p56/r3.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p56/r3.speaker: طائفة
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p56/r3.claim: Another group connects both clauses: unbelievers wish the earth would level them and wish they had not concealed the truth, regretting their lie that they were not polytheists.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p56/r3.anchor: وقالت طائفة: الكلام كله متصل، ومعناه: يود الذين كفروا لو تسوى بهم الأرض،

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p56/r4.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p56/r4.speaker: طائفة
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p56/r4.claim: A group says the clauses refer to separate places or episodes.

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p56/r5.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p56/r5.speaker: طائفة
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p56/r5.claim: Another group reads the wish as regret that they concealed the truth, not as a bargain offering concealment as ransom to be made earth.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p56/r5.anchor: وقالت طائفة: معنى الآية: يود الذين كفروا أن تسوى بهم الأرض، وأنهم لم يكتموا الله حديثا،

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p56/r6.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p56/r6.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p56/r6.claim: الرسول is singular but denotes the whole class of messengers.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p56/r6.anchor: والرسول في هذه الآية: للجنس، شرف بالذكر وهو مفرد دل على الجمع،

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p56/r7.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p56/r7.speaker: أبو السمال ويحيى بن يعمر
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p56/r7.claim: Abū al-Sammāl and Yaḥyā ibn Yaʿmar read عصوا الرسول with kasra on the wāw of عصوا.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v2p56/r7.anchor: وقرأ أبو السمال ويحيى بن يعمر: «وعصوا الرسول» بكسر الواو من عصوا.

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p86/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p86/r1.speaker: ابن كثير، عاصم، أبو عمرو
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p86/r1.claim: Ibn Kathīr, ʿĀṣim, and Abū ʿAmr read with ḍamma on tāʾ and a light sīn: the unbelievers wish they had been made dust, equal with the earth.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p86/r1.anchor: قرأ ابن كثير وعاصم وأبو عمرو لو تسوى بضم التاء وتخفيف السين والمعنى ودوا لو جعلوا ترابا فكانوا هم والأرض سواء

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p86/r2.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p86/r2.speaker: أبو هريرة
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p86/r2.claim: Abū Hurayra reports that at the gathering God will turn beasts, livestock, and birds to dust, prompting the unbeliever to wish he were dust too.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p86/r2.anchor: قال أبو هريرة إذا حشر الله الخلائق قال للبهائم والدواب والطير كوني ترابا فعندها يقول الكافر يا ليتني كنت ترابا

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p86/r3.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p86/r3.speaker: نافع، ابن عامر
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p86/r3.claim: Nāfiʿ and Ibn ʿĀmir read with fatḥa on tāʾ and a doubled sīn, from assimilation of the first tāʾ in the underlying form.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p86/r3.anchor: وقرأ نافع وابن عامر لو تسوى بفتح التاء وتشديد السين والمعنى لو تتسوى فأدغمت التاء في السين لقربها منها

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p86/r4.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p86/r4.speaker: أبو علي
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p86/r4.claim: Abū ʿAlī says this reading expands the construction: the wish is that people become level with the earth, not that the earth becomes like them.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p86/r4.anchor: قال أبو علي وفي هذه القراءة اتساع لأن الفعل مسند إلى الأرض وليس المراد ودوا لو صارت الأرض مثلهم وإنما المعنى ودوا لو يتسوون بها

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p86/r5.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p86/r5.speaker: قتادة، أبو عبيدة، مقاتل
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p86/r5.claim: One interpretation is that they wish the earth would split open and swallow them.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p86/r5.anchor: أحدهما أن معناه ودوا لو تخرقت بهم الأرض فساخوا فيها قاله قتادة وأبو عبيدة ومقاتل

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p86/r6.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p86/r6.speaker: ابن كيسان، الزجاج
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p86/r6.claim: Another interpretation is that they wish they had never been resurrected, since before emerging they lay level with the earth.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p86/r6.anchor: والثاني أن معناه ودوا أنهم لم يبعثوا لأن الأرض كانت مستوية بهم قبل خروجهم منها قاله ابن كيسان وذكر نحوه الزجاج

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p86/r7.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p86/r7.speaker: حمزة، الكسائي
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p86/r7.claim: Ḥamza and al-Kisāʾī read with fatḥa on tāʾ, a light sīn, and a doubled, imāla-pronounced wāw; its meaning matches the other readings.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p86/r7.anchor: وقرأ حمزة والكسائي لو تسوى بفتح التاء وتخفيف السين والواو مشددة ممالة وهي بمعنى تتسوى فحذف التاء التي أدغمها نافع وابن عامر فأما معنى القراءتين فواحد

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p87/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p87/r1.speaker: الجمهور
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p87/r1.claim: Most exegetes take the “report” they would not conceal to be their claim, “We were not polytheists.”
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p87/r1.anchor: أحدهما أنه قولهم ما كنا مشركين هذا قول الجمهور

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p87/r2.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p87/r2.speaker: عطاء
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p87/r2.claim: ʿAṭāʾ says the report is the Prophet's description and attributes; on this view they wish they had not concealed it in worldly life.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p87/r2.anchor: والثاني أنه أمر النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم وصفته ونعته قاله عطاء فعلى الأول يتعلق الكتمان بالآخرة وعلى الثاني يتعلق بما كان في الدنيا

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p87/r3.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p87/r3.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p87/r3.claim: One view is that when their limbs expose them, they wish they had not concealed their polytheism from God.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p87/r3.anchor: أحدها ودوا إذا فضحتهم جوارحهم أنهم لم يكتموا الله شركهم وهذا المعنى مروي عن ابن عباس

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p87/r4.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p87/r4.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p87/r4.claim: A second view says that after their limbs testify, they no longer conceal anything from God.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p87/r4.anchor: والثاني أنهم لما شهدت عليهم جوارحهم لم يكتموا الله حديثا بعد ذلك روي عن ابن عباس أيضا

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p87/r5.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p87/r5.speaker: الحسن
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p87/r5.claim: Al-Ḥasan says they do not conceal in one station, but in another they conceal and claim they were not polytheists.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p87/r5.anchor: والثالث أنهم في موطن لا يكتمونه حديثا وفي موطن يكتمون ويقولون ما كنا مشركين قاله الحسن

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p87/r6.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p87/r6.speaker: الفراء، الزجاج
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p87/r6.claim: Al-Farrāʾ and al-Zajjāj take this as a new sentence: their inability to conceal anything follows because it is evident to God.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p87/r6.anchor: كلام مستأنف لا يتعلق بقوله لو تسوى بهم الأرض هذا قول الفراء والزجاج ومعنى لا يكتمون الله حديثا لا يقدرون على كتمانه لأنه ظاهر عند الله

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p87/r7.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p87/r7.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p87/r7.claim: A fifth view reads the two clauses together: they wish both that the earth were leveled over them and that they had not concealed anything from God.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p87/r7.anchor: والخامس أن المعنى ودوا لو سويت بهم الأرض وأنهم لم يكتموا الله حديثا

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p87/r8.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p87/r8.speaker: ابن الأنباري
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p87/r8.claim: A sixth view says they did not regard their claim of not being polytheists as a lie, since they thought worshipping idols was obedience.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p87/r8.anchor: والسادس أنهم لم يعتقدوا قولهم ما كنا مشركين كذبا وإنما اعتقدوا أن عبادة الأصنام طاعة ذكر القولين ابن الأنباري

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p87/r9.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p87/r9.speaker: القاضي أبو يعلى
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p87/r9.claim: Qāḍī Abū Yaʿlā says they reported what they believed, thinking themselves non-polytheists, but this does not mean they were not lying.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v2p87/r9.anchor: وقال القاضي أبو يعلى أخبروا بما توهموا إذ كانوا يظنون أنهم ليسوا بمشركين وذلك لا يخرجهم عن أن يكونوا قد كذبوا

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p307#2/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p307#2/r1.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p307#2/r1.claim: Seeing the terrors, disgrace, exposure, and rebuke of Judgment, the disbelievers wish the earth would split and swallow them, as in 78:40.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p307#2/r1.anchor: أي: لو انشقت وبلعتهم، مما يرون من أهوال الموقف، وما يحل بهم من الخزي والفضيحة والتوبيخ،

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p307#2/r2.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p307#2/r2.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p307#2/r2.claim: They will acknowledge everything they did and conceal none of it.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p307#2/r2.anchor: أخبر (8) عنهم بأنهم يعترفون بجميع ما فعلوه، ولا يكتمون منه شيئا.

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p307#2/r3.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p307#2/r3.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p307#2/r3.claim: Ibn Abbas explains that the polytheists first deny association when they realize only Muslims enter Paradise, but God seals their mouths and their hands and feet testify to their deeds, reconciling the denial in 6:23 with the later admission.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p307#2/r3.anchor: فقال ابن العباس: أما قوله: {والله ربنا ما كنا مشركين} فإنهم لما رأوا أنه لا يدخل الجنة إلا أهل الإسلام

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p307#2/r4.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p307#2/r4.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p307#2/r4.claim: In Abd al-Razzaq's version, Ibn Abbas says they deny shirk hoping for forgiveness when they realize God forgives sins but not shirk; their mouths are then sealed and their limbs testify, explaining how they ultimately conceal nothing despite 6:23.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p307#2/r4.anchor: قال ابن عباس: أما قوله: {ثم لم تكن فتنتهم إلا أن قالوا والله ربنا ما كنا مشركين} فإنهم لما رأوا يوم القيامة أن الله لا يغفر إلا لأهل الإسلام

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p308/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p308/r1.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p308/r1.claim: Ibn Abbas tells Nafi ibn al-Azraq that all people gather on one plain; polytheists deny shirk because they know only monotheists are accepted, but their mouths are sealed and their limbs testify, after which they wish to be leveled with the earth.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v2p308/r1.anchor: فقال له ابن عباس: إني أحسبك قمت من عند أصحابك فقلت ألقي على ابن عباس متشابه القرآن. فإذا رجعت إليهم فأخبرهم

JISHUMI:v2p1561/r13.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1561/r13.speaker: author
